description: This Scala source file defines a GrpcRetryHandler class for managing retries of gRPC calls with exponential backoff, including support for retrying iterators and stream observers, within the Apache Spark SQL connect client module.

classes.name: GrpcRetryHandler
classes.description: Handles retry logic for gRPC calls, including retries for functions, iterators, and stream observers.

classes.name: GrpcRetryHandler.RetryIterator
classes.description: Wraps an iterator to add retry logic for each call to next() and hasNext().

classes.name: GrpcRetryHandler.RetryStreamObserver
classes.description: Wraps a StreamObserver to add retry logic for onNext, onError, and onCompleted calls.

classes.name: GrpcRetryHandler.Retrying
classes.description: Manages the state and logic for retry attempts with policies and backoff.

classes.name: GrpcRetryHandler.RetryException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a retryable error.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Retries a function with exponential backoff according to policies.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Factory methods for creating RetryIterator and RetryStreamObserver instances.

methods.name: canRetry
methods.description: Determines if an exception is retryable based on policies.

methods.name: makeAttempt
methods.description: Attempts to execute the function, catching retryable exceptions.

methods.name: waitAfterAttempt
methods.description: Handles waiting between retries based on policies or throws if retries are exhausted.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Performs the retry loop until success.
